title: ClawHub vs Custom OpenClaw Skills: When to Build vs When to Install
summary: ClawHub has 5,400+ OpenClaw skills. Learn when to install from the registry vs build a custom skill — with specific criteria, examples, and a self-hosting guide.
body_markdown: Yes. Blink Claw runs the full OpenClaw runtime, so all ClawHub skills install and work identically. You still configure them via` SOUL.md` as you would locally. The benefit is that Blink Claw runs 24/7 — your skills keep working even when your laptop is off. Blink Claw starts from about $45/month per agent, with AI model usage billed from your workspace credits and no Docker setup required.
